license_required.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice nursing, offer to practice nursing, assist in the practice of nursing, or use any title, abbreviation, or designation to indicate that the person is practicing nursing or assisting in the practice of nursing in this state unless that person is currently licensed or registered under this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the North Dakota board of nursing.

name.quote: "Board" means the North Dakota board of nursing.

type.quote: There is a state board of nursing whose members must be appointed by the governor which must consist of five registered nurses, one advanced practice registered nurse, two licensed practical nurses, and one public member.

degree_required.value: Completion of a board-approved nursing education program (graduate degree with nursing focus for APRN)
degree_required.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse applicant must have a graduate degree with a nursing focus or must have completed the educational requirements in effect when the applicant was initially licensed.

accrediting_body.value: State board of nursing of the jurisdiction in which the program is headquartered
accrediting_body.quote: submit an official transcript that verifies completion of an out-of-state nursing education program that is approved by the state board of nursing of the jurisdiction in which the program is headquartered

exams.name: Board-approved examination (NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN)
exams.notes: Required for licensure by examination for RN and LPN
exams.quote: Pass an examination approved by the board.

required.quote: Adopt and enforce rules for continuing competence of licensees and registrants.

available.quote: An applicant for licensure by endorsement to practice as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse shall: Submit a completed application and appropriate fee as established by the board.

requirements.value: Submit official transcript, proof of initial licensure by examination meeting ND requirements, and evidence of current unencumbered licensure in another state or jurisdiction or meet continued competency requirements.
requirements.quote: Submit evidence of current unencumbered licensure in another state or jurisdiction or meet continued competency requirements as established by the board.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice nursing, offer to practice nursing, assist in the practice of nursing, or use any title, abbreviation, or designation to indicate that the person is practicing nursing or assisting in the practice of nursing in this state unless that person is currently licensed or registered under this chapter.

credential_type.quote: Any person who provides nursing care to a resident of this state must hold a current license or registration issued by the board.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice nursing, offer to practice nursing, assist in the practice of nursing, or use any title, abbreviation, or designation to indicate that the person is practicing nursing or assisting in the practice of nursing in this state unless that person is currently licensed or registered under this chapter.

title_protection.quote: A person may not use the title "nurse" or be referred to as a "nurse" unless the person is currently licensed by the board or exempt under section 43-12.1-04.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice nursing, offer to practice nursing, assist in the practice of nursing, or use any title, abbreviation, or designation to indicate that the person is practicing nursing or assisting in the practice of nursing in this state unless that person is currently licensed or registered under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Arrested, charged, or convicted of a crime that relates adversely to the practice of nursing without demonstrated sufficient rehabilitation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been arrested, charged, or convicted by a court, or has entered a plea of nolo contendere to a crime in any jurisdiction that relates adversely to the practice of nursing and the licensee or registrant has not demonstrated sufficient rehabilitation under section 12.1-33-02.1

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplined by a board of nursing in another jurisdiction or had a license denied, revoked, suspended, or otherwise sanctioned.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined by a board of nursing in another jurisdiction, or has had a license or registration to practice nursing or to assist in the practice of nursing or to practice in another health care occupation or profession denied, revoked, suspended, or otherwise sanctioned

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any practice inconsistent with the standards of nursing practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any practice inconsistent with the standards of nursing practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or attempted to obtain a license by fraud or deceit, or submitted fraudulent, deceitful, or false information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or attempted to obtain by fraud or deceit a license or registration to practice nursing, or has submitted to the board any information that is fraudulent, deceitful, or false

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in a pattern of practice or other behavior that demonstrates professional misconduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in a pattern of practice or other behavior that demonstrates professional misconduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diverted or attempted to divert supplies, equipment, drugs, or controlled substances for personal or unauthorized use.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has diverted or attempted to divert supplies, equipment, drugs, or controlled substances for personal use or unauthorized use

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced nursing or assisted in the practice of nursing without a current license or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced nursing or assisted in the practice of nursing in this state without a current license or registration or as otherwise prohibited by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report any violation of this chapter or rules adopted under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report any violation of this chapter or rules adopted under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to observe and follow the duly adopted standards, policies, directives, and orders of the board, or violated any other provision of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to observe and follow the duly adopted standards, policies, directives, and orders of the board, or has violated any other provision of this chapter.

definition_quote.value: "Nursing" means the performance of acts utilizing specialized knowledge, skills, and abilities for people in a variety of settings.
definition_quote.quote: "Nursing" means the performance of acts utilizing specialized knowledge, skills, and abilities for people in a variety of settings.

value: maintenance of health and prevention of illness
assessing and diagnosing human responses to actual or potential health problems
providing supportive and restorative care and nursing treatment, medication administration, health counseling and teaching, case finding and referral
administration, teaching, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of health and nursing practices
collaboration with other health care professionals in the implementation of the total health care regimen
methods_authorized.quote: The term includes the following acts, which may not be deemed to include acts of medical diagnosis or treatment or the practice of medicine as defined in chapter 43-17

drug_authority.value: Prescriptive practices means assessing the need for drugs, immunizing agents, or devices and writing a prescription to be filled by a licensed pharmacist (for APRNs).
drug_authority.quote: "Prescriptive practices" means assessing the need for drugs, immunizing agents, or devices and writing a prescription to be filled by a licensed pharmacist.

license_tiers.quote: "Nurse" means an individual who is currently licensed as an advanced practice registered nurse, specialty practice registered nurse, registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current license to practice in this state as an advanced practice registered nurse within one of the roles of certified nurse practitioner, certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified nurse midwife, or certified clinical nurse specialist

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Licensed practical nurse" means an individual who holds a current license to practice in this state as a licensed practical nurse and who practices dependently under the supervision of a registered nurse, specialty practice registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or licensed practitioner.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse issued a multistate license may assume responsibility and accountability for patient care independent of any supervisory or collaborative relationship.

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: Has practiced for at least two thousand eighty hours as an advanced practice registered nurse in a role and population focus congruent with the applicant's education and training.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The department shall establish and administer a nurse aide registry. The registry must include disciplinary findings, including findings of abuse, neglect, or misappropriation of property, and must include the eligibility of the individual to be employed.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication assistant" means an individual who is registered on the nurse aide registry and who has successfully completed the requirements of a department-approved medication assistant program for a specific employment setting. A medication assistant may be designated a medication assistant I or a medication assistant II.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A nurse may supervise and delegate nursing interventions to an individual exempt under subsection 13 of section 43-12.1-04.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The party states hereby create and establish a joint public entity known as the Interstate Commission of Nurse Licensure Compact Administrators.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse issued by a home state licensing board which authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative to discipline" means a voluntary alternative to traditional discipline program designed for nurses with substance use disorders, behavioral health conditions, or medical health conditions.
